npc_thunder_peak_1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original dark-fantasy RPG enemy PIXEL ART animation sheet, matching our approved weathered skeletons and desert NPCs: dark brown-black crisp contours, angular low-resolution pixel clusters, material shading and a restrained varied palette. Grounded 16-bit game sprite style, not chibi, smooth painting, vector, 3D or glossy icon. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY 6 columns x 4 rows of separate characters = 24 full-body poses, equal cells on a square canvas. The figures must be SMALL inside the cells: occupy only central 55% of each cell width, with at least 22% clear transparent padding BOTH SIDES and broad gutters between ALL individual silhouettes. Fully show every foot, wing, horn, tail, weapon and corpse, never touching another frame or a canvas edge. Same character, same full-body scale and LEFT-facing three-quarter side camera in every cell. Rows top to bottom IDLE/MOVE/ATTACK/DIE, six actual articulated poses per row. Idle/move loops, attack windup/contact/recover, death complete final settled remains near the same floor baseline. No captions, text, labels, borders, grids, floor, background objects, or cast shadows. No half bodies. Never replace the death sequence with isolated heads or a fully transparent last frame. The whole creature remains fully inside its own cell even when lunging, opening wings or lying down.
Character: 雷羽鷹 (thunder_peak_1). A THUNDERFEATHER EAGLE, complete eagle with full steel-blue and charcoal wings, cream head and golden beak/talons, a few sharp pale violet feather accents.
Palette: 鋼藍／雷金. Full original anatomy suited to this monster; keep all equipment consistent.
Idle: six articulated hovering wingbeat poses with a stable head/body root, full raised/downstroke wings. Move: distinct forward-flight wing cycle, body leans LEFT and wings sweep back. Attack: hover ready, recoil head/body, wings draw back, decisive LEFT bite/claw or tiny mouth breath appropriate to the described creature, brace and recover; no disconnected giant effects. Death: recoil in air, wings crumple, body tilts/drops, lands, wings fold, complete grounded corpse. Every wing tip remains inside the cell.
Return ONLY the clean transparent 24-frame sprite sheet.
